summary.name: Virtual Staging AI
summary.one_liner: A web app that uses AI to add or replace furniture in photos of rooms, so vacant or dated property listings look furnished.
use_cases: Furnishing empty rooms for real estate marketing
Removing existing furniture from listing photos
Trying different furniture designs for a room
Creating listing-ready images quickly without a designer
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a photo of a room, and the AI adds furniture within about 15 seconds. It can also remove existing furniture before adding new pieces. The page says users can regenerate designs without extra cost, and that there are 50+ design styles. The staged image can then be downloaded and used in listings. The page is mostly marketing, and it cites industry statistics about staging, which are not verified here.
notable: Adds furniture to room photos in about 15 seconds
Can remove existing furniture before restaging
caveats: Starts at $16 a month for 6 staged images, per the page
Page does not say whether a free tier exists
Mostly marketing claims; staging statistics are not sourced
